title: East Nashville 4BR Craftsman | Minutes to Downtown
description:
Step into this beautiful, newly renovated 4 bedroom, 3 full bath craftsman home located minutes from downtown Nashville/Broadway, Five Points, and the city’s best dining, music, and nightlife. This modern house blends classic charm with modern comfort featuring high-end finishes, smart thermostats, a large updated kitchen, open living and dining, and a private backyard with outdoor seating, making it ideal for families, friend groups, and longer stays.

✨Experience East Nashville Like a Local✨

The space
2-story craftsman home with 4 bedrooms (2 king beds, 2 queen beds) and 3 full bathrooms. Full kitchen with island, stove, dishwasher, microwave, and coffee machine. Dining room. Living room with bonus living space upstairs. Included washer and dryer. Large backyard with outdoor seating area for entertaining.

Please note: king bedroom upstairs is loft/studio style with second private queen bedroom with door. The two share a bath.

Guest access
Full access of home and yard

Other things to note
Advanced check in and delayed check out may be available at a rate of 25 dollars per hour.
